claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 accurately represents paragraph (a) general prohibition on takeoff with inoperative instruments or equipment unless the conditions are met or paragraph (d) applies.
Claim C0001 correctly captures the requirement under paragraph (a)(1) that an approved Minimum Equipment List must exist for the aircraft.

Claim C0002 correctly captures the requirement under paragraph (a)(2) that the aircraft have within it a letter of authorization issued by the responsible Flight Standards office authorizing operation under the MEL.
Claim C0003 correctly reflects the provision in paragraph (a)(2) stating that the letter of authorization may be obtained by written request of the airworthiness certificate holder.
Claim C0004 accurately conveys the statement in paragraph (a)(2) that the MEL and letter of authorization constitute a supplemental type certificate for the aircraft.

Claim C0005 completely captures both required elements of paragraph (a)(3): preparation in accordance with paragraph (b) limitations and provision for operation with instruments/equipment in an inoperable condition.
Claim C0006 accurately represents paragraph (a)(4) regarding the entry describing inoperable instruments and equipment in aircraft records available to the pilot.
Claim C0007 correctly states the condition in paragraph (a)(5) requiring operation under all applicable conditions and limitations in the MEL and letter of authorization.
Claim C0008 fully specifies the three categories of instruments and equipment that may not be included in a Minimum Equipment List pursuant to paragraph (b).
Claim C0009 correctly conveys paragraph (c) requirement that authorized persons under subpart K, part 121, 125, or 135 must use the approved MEL to comply with § 91.213.
Claim C0010 accurately and comprehensively captures the permission and all four conditions of paragraph (d) for takeoff without an approved MEL.

Claim C0011 correctly specifies the rule in paragraph (d)(3)(ii) that if deactivation of the inoperative instrument or equipment involves maintenance, it must be accomplished and recorded in accordance with part 43.
Claim C0012 accurately conveys the closing provision of paragraph (d) regarding properly altered condition acceptable to the Administrator.
Claim C0013 correctly reflects paragraph (e) permission allowing operation with inoperable instruments or equipment under a special flight permit pursuant to §§ 21.197 and 21.199.
